sign: South: Madderby   North: the Mirror Rift
pond: The pond is so still that the sky looks deeper than the water.
East: the Greyreach, closed by the guild for now.
teo: Teo: Nothing bites since the colour went. I keep coming anyway.
teo_intro: Teo: You scared the fish. Not that there were any.
teo_defeat: Teo: Ha. That was more fun than fishing.
runa: Runa: We grow rice on the steps. Grey rice this year.
runa_intro: Runa: Mind the dykes! And mind my team.
runa_defeat: Runa: You're steadier than the dykes.
ivo: Ivo: Up there you see yourself. Only yourself. Hold on to something real.
ivo_intro: Ivo: Let's see if you look away first.
ivo_defeat: Ivo: Good. You'll do up there.
